footer.tagline: Coliseum of Souls - Tactics | Summoned by The Void

tips: A balanced team is the key to victory.
Keep your <Range> ability characters away from melee enemies to maximize their effectiveness.
Know your team's abilities before jumping in.
Board positioning is just as important as attacking.
Use map obstacles to block lines of sight and protect your allies.
Save a strong character for the decisive moment.
Status effects like <Burned>, <Poisoned>, or <Frozen> can change the course of a match — use them wisely.
Characters with <Taunt> abilities force enemies to attack them; place them next to your vulnerable allies.
Pushing enemies into obstacles can deal extra damage or limit their mobility.
Use the terrain and map corridors to create chokepoints and limit your enemies' options.
A substitute can turn the tide of battle.
Always check your allies' health — protecting low-HP characters can swing the match in your favor.

slides.title: Welcome — Player's Guide
slides.content:
Welcome to Coliseum of Souls - Tactics. In this guide you will learn everything you need to enter the battlefield with confidence.

Use the arrows or keys ← → to navigate.

slides.title: What is it about?
slides.content:
It's a turn-based 1 vs 1 strategy game. You and your rival face each other on a hexagonal board with your teams of characters.

🏆 Goal: eliminate 3 characters from your rival to win the match.

slides.title: The Board
slides.content:
The battle takes place on a board of hexagonal cells. Each cell can be empty, occupied by a character, an obstacle or an item.

🗺️ The map is random in each match.🔵 Each side of the map belongs to a player.🧱 It can have obstacles and items distributed.

slides.title: Your Characters
slides.content:
Each character has 4 attributes and a unique passive ability:
  • ❤️ HP — Health points. When it reaches 0, the character is eliminated.
  • ⚔️ Attack — Damage dealt when attacking (and counterattacking).
  • 🏃 Mobility — Maximum cells it can move per turn.
  • 🎯 Range — Melee (1 cell distance) and Ranged (2 cells distance).

slides.title: Building your Roster
slides.content:
Before each match you select exactly 8 characters for your team.

💡 Combine different roles: tanks with high HP, attackers with high damage, and characters with special abilities that complement your strategy.

slides.title: Starters and Reserves
slides.content:
From your 8 characters, you split the team into two groups:

  • 🔵 3 Starters — Start the match on the board.
  • 🟡 5 in Reserve — Wait off the board, ready to enter when a starter falls.
💡 Keep your most powerful characters in reserve to surprise your rival with their abilities.

slides.title: Deployment Phase
slides.content:
At the start of the match, both players place their 3 starters in their own zone of the map.

  • 📍 You decide which cell to place each character in.
  • 🚫 You cannot place them in the rival's zone.
  • ⚠️ Once confirmed, you cannot change the position.
Think about nearby obstacles and possible routes before confirming.

slides.title: Your Turn: Move
slides.content:
On your turn, each character can move up to its Mobility value in cells.

  • 🚧 You cannot pass through obstacles or occupied cells.
  • ✅ You can move before attacking.
💡 If the cell where a character is located is filled with color (blue - yours/red - enemy), it means that character can still move.⚠️ If you attack first, that character loses the option to move that turn.

slides.title: Your Turn: Attack
slides.content:
Each character can attack an enemy within its Range. The damage dealt is equal to its Attack value.

  • 🗡️ Range 1 = melee (adjacent cell).
  • 🎯 Range 2 = ranged attack.
  • 👁️ Ranged attacks require line of sight to the target.
💡 If the cell where a character is located has a colored outline (blue - yours/red - enemy), it means that character can still attack.

slides.title: The Counterattack
slides.content:
When you attack an enemy, they can counterattack automatically using their own Attack value.

The defender counterattacks only if:📏 The attacker is within their range.👁️ They have line of sight to the attacker.🔄 They have not already counterattacked this turn.💡 If the cell where a character is located is filled with color (orange - yours and enemies), it means that character can still counterattack.💡 Attacking from outside enemy range avoids counterattack.

slides.title: Obstacles
slides.content:
The map has obstacles like rocks and walls that block movement and vision.

  • 🚧 They block movement of characters.
  • 👁️ They block line of sight for ranged attacks.
  • 💥 You can attack them to destroy them and open new routes.
  • 🛡️ Use them as cover to protect your characters.

slides.title: Map Items
slides.content:
The map has items that are collected by positioning a character on that cell. Any player can pick them up.
  • ❤️ Health — Restores HP to the character that picks it up.
  • ⚔️ Attack — Grants extra damage on the next attack.
  • 🛡️ Shield — Blocks all damage from the next attack or counterattack received.

slides.title: Reserve System
slides.content:
When a character is eliminated, you can choose one of your reserve characters to enter the board.

  • ❤️ Enters with full HP.
  • 📍 You decide which cell to place them in.
  • ✨ Their entry ability activates when they appear (if they have one).
💡 A good reserve character can completely turn the tide of battle.⚠️ In each match only 2 reserve characters can enter, the third eliminated character cannot be replaced and ends the match.

slides.title: Let's Win!
slides.content:
Eliminate 3 of your rival's characters — starters and substitutes — to win the match.

  • 🎯 Prioritize enemies with less HP.
  • 🗺️ Control the map and collect items.
  • ✨ Use your passive abilities wisely.
  • 🔄 Save your best characters for decisive moments.
Let the battle begin! ⚔️
